answer: Pay for presence, not paperwork. Each identity holds a liveness lease: a random peer may demand a signed nonce in 30 seconds, routed over a randomly drawn bridge, not its usual path. Probes scale with claimed weight, so a thousand clones absorb a thousand probes. That needs a thousand endpoints live at odd hours on distinct address blocks; one proxy rack collapses into a single cluster and forfeits the batch. No saffron veneer survives a missed window: weight decays per missed probe, and reinstatement needs a fresh voyage of audited tasks. Renting many routes costs more than a clone earns.
